title: SAGE: Optimal-Stopping Peer Selection for Decentralised Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.23773v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decentralised federated learning replaces server aggregation with peer-to-peer model exchange, making collaborator selection a local decision under uncertainty. Fixed probe budgets waste effort on easy choices yet fall short when peers are hard to distinguish. We propose SAGE (Sequential Anchor-Gated Exchange), an optimal-stopping peer selector under a one-model-bearing-exchange budget. A receiver scores candidate neighbours on receiver-owned anchor evidence and selects once an advantage is certified. It continues probing only while further evidence repays its cost, and otherwise falls back to random gossip. We show that the stopping problem admits an optimal rule attained at a finite stage, and that the anchor schedule is order-optimal in the peer-risk gap and the confidence level. We further show that the selector never returns a peer worse than random gossip with high probability, and prove that no such guarantee holds for selectors

translated_title: SAGE：面向去中心化联邦学习的最优停止同伴选择方法
translated_abstract: 去中心化联邦学习用点对点模型交换取代了服务器聚合，使得协作者选择成为不确定性下的本地决策。固定的探测预算在容易的选择上浪费精力，而在同伴难以区分时又显得不足。我们提出SAGE（Sequential Anchor-Gated Exchange，顺序锚点门控交换），一种在单次承载模型交换预算下的最优停止同伴选择器。接收者基于其自有的锚点证据对候选邻居进行评分，一旦优势得到认证即完成选择。只有当进一步的证据能够补偿其成本时，选择器才继续探测，否则回退到随机gossip。我们证明该停止问题存在可在有限阶段达到的最优规则，并且锚点调度在同伴风险差距和置信水平上是阶数最优的。我们进一步证明该选择器以高概率绝不会返回比随机gossip更差的同伴，并证明对于（固定预算的）选择器而言不存在这样的保证。
tldr: 提出SAGE，一种基于最优停止理论、在单次模型交换预算下自适应决定何时停止探测的去中心化联邦学习同伴选择方法，并以高概率保证所选同伴不劣于随机gossip。
en_tdlr: SAGE is an optimal-stopping peer selector for decentralised federated learning that adaptively decides when to stop probing under a one-model-exchange budget, provably never selecting a peer worse than random gossip with high probability.
